tool_args.rationale: The long forecast horizon and fast-transient signature make horizon dependence potentially important. A fine trajectory batch is the available relevant probe to distinguish transient behavior from an almost linear dependence on u_now before committing to a model.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit a smooth stationary law from the five rows now
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The rows vary together in u_past, u_now, x_now, and mem_conv, while s_grad is always zero and H spans only 0.6. Effects of transient/history terms are not separately identifiable.
It is explicitly a nuisance measurement and is not needed to resolve the model ambiguity.
